tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: App background behind panels and the calendar.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, table rows, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Sidebar, table headers, empty calendar slots, read-only fields.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Dividers, card outlines, calendar grid lines. Decorative only.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Input, select and checkbox borders (3:1 on surface-card).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on any surface token (14:1 on surface-page).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, timestamps, helper text (5.3:1 on surface-page). Never for anything the user must act on.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, selected day, active nav item, links. White text on it passes 4.7:1.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of primary.

tokens.name: primary-subtle
tokens.usage: Selected row, today column in calendar, active filter chip.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus outline, offset 2px.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons and error text (6.5:1 on white).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons (5.9:1 on white).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons (5.1:1 on white).

tokens.name: status-staged-bg
tokens.usage: Draft change not yet committed (staged move, assignment or new session). Card also gets a dashed border-staged outline.

tokens.name: status-staged-fg
tokens.usage: Label text on status-staged-bg (6.1:1).

tokens.name: border-staged
tokens.usage: 1px dashed outline on staged cards, so drafts read differently from committed sessions without relying on color alone.

tokens.name: status-conflict-bg
tokens.usage: Session that clashes with leave, a room or another booking. Needs action.

tokens.name: status-conflict-fg
tokens.usage: Label and warning icon on status-conflict-bg (5.9:1). Also the conflict count badge text.

tokens.name: status-leave-bg
tokens.usage: Recorded therapist leave blocks on the calendar and in the leave list.

tokens.name: status-leave-fg
tokens.usage: Label text on status-leave-bg (6.9:1).

tokens.name: status-cancelled-bg
tokens.usage: Staged cancellation. Pair with strikethrough time.

tokens.name: status-cancelled-fg
tokens.usage: Label text on status-cancelled-bg (6.2:1).

tokens.name: status-past-bg
tokens.usage: Historical alerts and sessions that already happened. Deliberately quiet.

tokens.name: status-past-fg
tokens.usage: Label text on status-past-bg (6.0:1).

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per screen: Schedule, Clients, Billing.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text, table cells, form values.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Client names in lists, key values.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, column headers, status pills.

styles.name: time
styles.usage: Appointment times and dates in the calendar. Use tabular numbers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, pill padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; calendar card padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, input padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between panels; page gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Separation between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Status pills, checkboxes, calendar appointment cards.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dropdowns, popovers, dialogs only. Panels use borders, not shadows.
